intro: A cybersecurity analyst resume that shows incidents handled, risks reduced and the controls you built, with certifications up front.
tips: Quantify: alerts triaged, incidents handled, time to respond.
Show controls and programmes you built, not just tools you used.
Put certifications where they are easy to find.

basics.name: Aisha Rahman
basics.label: Cybersecurity Analyst
basics.summary: Security analyst with five years in a 24/7 security operations centre and on cloud security. I find the real threats in the noise and fix the gaps that let them in.

work.name: Maple Financial
highlights: Triage 200 alerts a day; tuned detection rules to cut false positives by 60%.
Led response to a phishing campaign: contained in two hours, no accounts lost.
Ran the phishing simulation programme; click rates fell from 14% to 3%.

work.name: SecureOps
highlights: Monitored 30 client networks in Splunk and escalated incidents by playbook.
Wrote 20 playbooks that became the team standard.
